rules.name: R1
rules.text: IF women-related target AND sexualized remark or objectification THEN Sexual-Harassment.

rules.name: R2
rules.text: IF women-related target AND threat, violent intent, or encouragement of physical harm THEN Violence.

rules.name: R3
rules.text: IF women-related target AND gender-based inferiority, exclusion, or stereotype THEN Misogyny.

rules.name: R4
rules.text: IF women-related target AND ridicule of face, body, clothing, or physical appearance THEN Appearance-Attack.

rules.name: R5
rules.text: IF women-related target AND reputation attack, moral judgement, or derogatory allegation THEN Character-Assassination.

rules.name: R6
rules.text: IF a Sexual-Harassment cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN Explicit-Harm.

rules.name: R7
rules.text: IF a Violence cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN Explicit-Harm.

rules.name: R8
rules.text: IF a Misogyny cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN Explicit-Harm.

rules.name: R9
rules.text: IF a Appearance-Attack cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN Explicit-Harm.

rules.name: R10
rules.text: IF a Character-Assassination cue directly refers to the identified women-related target THEN Explicit-Harm.

rules.name: R11
rules.text: IF a Sexual-Harassment interpretation requires implication or association THEN Implicit-Harm.

rules.name: R12
rules.text: IF a Violence interpretation requires implication or association THEN Implicit-Harm.

rules.name: R13
rules.text: IF a Misogyny interpretation requires implication or association THEN Implicit-Harm.

rules.name: R14
rules.text: IF a Appearance-Attack interpretation requires implication or association THEN Implicit-Harm.

rules.name: R15
rules.text: IF a Character-Assassination interpretation requires implication or association THEN Implicit-Harm.

rules.name: R16
rules.text: IF women-related target AND explicit threat AND violent cue THEN Explicit-Harm / Violence.

rules.name: R17
rules.text: IF women-related target AND weapon present AND visual evidence THEN Explicit-Harm / Violence.

rules.name: R18
rules.text: IF women-related target AND sarcasm AND misogynistic cue THEN Implicit-Harm / Misogyny.

rules.name: R19
rules.text: IF the harmful reading requires cultural knowledge THEN increase Implicit-Harm support.

rules.name: R20
rules.text: IF the harmful reading requires image-text association THEN increase Implicit-Harm support.

rules.name: E1
rules.text: IF a harmful expression is quoted AND explicitly condemned THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E2
rules.text: IF harmful language is quoted or depicted without endorsement THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E3
rules.text: IF the meme raises awareness or reports harm THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E4
rules.text: IF a stereotype is explicitly rejected or corrected THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E5
rules.text: IF the meme praises, empowers, or affirms equality for women THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E6
rules.text: IF no women-related target is addressed THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E7
rules.text: IF misogyny is mentioned AND condemned THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E8
rules.text: IF a sexual cue is mentioned AND condemned THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E9
rules.text: IF violence is depicted AND awareness is raised THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E10
rules.text: IF an appearance stereotype is challenged THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: E11
rules.text: IF a character attack is quoted AND criticized THEN Non-Harm.

rules.name: G1
rules.text: IF image and OCR text conflict THEN reduce the neural-symbolic confidence gate.

rules.name: G2
rules.text: IF retrieved knowledge is weakly matched THEN reduce the confidence gate.

rules.name: G3
rules.text: IF harm-supporting and exception rules conflict THEN reduce the confidence gate.

rules.name: G4
rules.text: IF no women-related target is detected THEN reduce the confidence gate.

rules.name: G5
rules.text: IF multimodal evidence is weak THEN reduce the confidence gate.
